warnings: The UPPER-floor bathroom. Comparing it with WC1 on A-24 is the point: WC2 is smaller (2.40 x 2.90 against 2.30 x 3.40) and has NO wheelchair turning circle drawn, no folding rails and no H1/H2/H3/H4 shower-rail set -- only two plain H rails. That is consistent with the A-03 brief, which puts the accessible accommodation on the ground floor and the upper floor for occupants without mobility problems.

*** WC2 HAS TWO FLOOR LEVELS IN ONE ROOM: +3.35 dry side and +3.33 wet side, with a SLOPE arrow and a 0.05 dimension. *** Two separate room tags are printed. WC1 downstairs is a single +0.38 throughout. A take-off reading one tag per room will miss this.

IT ALSO HAS FITTINGS WC1 DOES NOT: a 20 mm GRANITE vanity top ('TOP หินแกรนิต หนา 2 ซม', 0.60 m deep), a counter-mounted basin LAV1 rather than the plain LAV, and mirror M1 rather than M. Three mark variants that only differ upstairs.
Wall finish 2 (ceramic tile) is tagged all round, as in WC1.

SP, PH and S are used here without expansion -- RESOLVED by A-29 (PNG 31): soap dish, wall paper holder and chrome bidet spray. The H mark is resolved there too, and the reading taken on this sheet was WRONG: H is a chrome TOWEL RAIL at 1.50 m, not a grab rail. *** So WC2 contains NO grab rail of any kind *** -- the full H1/H2/H3 set and the owner-supplied H4 shower seat are ground-floor only, which is exactly what the A-03 brief says (accessible accommodation downstairs, upper floor for occupants without mobility problems).
Sections A and B are cut from here to A-28.
